I am vehemently opposed to this ban on the VA providing abortion care to active military, veterans, and spouses. Abortion care is health care. Lack of care has many detrimental effects. Nonviable pregnancies can cause the death of women. It is traumatic to force women who are victims of rape, domestic or otherwise, to bring a pregnancy to term. The practice of denying women health care will cause future medical issues with ongoing consequences. I am not an eloquent writer so I have attached a scholarly document regarding this issue. Reproductive care is health care and should not be denied to women under VA care.

Victoria Kea
U.S. Citizen
